package ingester

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseDiscoveryTimeCache(t *testing.T) {
	a := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesRequest{TagName: "resource.service.name", Query: `{resource.service.namespace="example"}`, Start: 10, End: 11}
	b := *a
	b.Start = 20
	b.End = 21
	same := searchTagValuesV2CacheKey(a, 100, "prefix") == searchTagValuesV2CacheKey(&b, 100, "prefix")
	if !same {
		t.Fatal("reference cache now respects time; revisit deferred Pulse contract")
	}
	raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"different_time_ranges_share_key": same}, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-intrinsics/time-cache-oracle.json", append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
